app-title: Cibiyar Ilimi ta Africa Pioneers - Waje
welcome-sub: Ƙofar Ƙarfafa Africa Ta Hanyar Pi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Don murnar Ranar Africa ta 25, wannan Aikace-aikacen Horar da Pi Pioneers an ƙaddamar da shi)
memorial-title: 🕊️ Don Tunawa da Ƙaunatacciya Christina Muzheki Manjengwa
memorial-text:
Wannan Cibiyar Ilimi an sadaukar da ita ga ƴar uwata babba ƙaunatacciya Christina Muzheki Manjengwa wacce ta huta a ranar 8 ga Agusta 2026 kuma aka binne ta a ranar 11 ga Agusta kasancewar Ranar Jaruman Zimbabwe.
Ƙaunarki, jagorancinki da ƙarfinki na ci gaba da ƙarfafa manufarmu ta ƙarfafa Africa.
Har abada a cikin zukatanmu. Huta cikin salama, 'Yar uwa.
intro-p1: Pi Network kuɗi ne na dijital da aikin ecosystem na duniya wanda aka tsara don sanya cryptocurrency ya zama mai sauƙi da amfani ga kowa.
intro-p2: Ba kamar cryptocurrencies na gargajiya waɗanda ke buƙatar injinan hakar ma'adinai masu tsada ba, Pi Network yana bawa talakawa damar shiga kai tsaye daga wayoyinsu.
intro-list:
• Gina tattalin arzikin dijital mai haɗa kowa ba tare da bankuna ba
  • Ƙarfafa talakawa a duniya ta hanyar hakar ma'adinai ta waya
  • Ƙara amfani na gaske ta hanyar utilities da DApps
  • Taimaka kasuwanci tsakanin mutum da mutum da rage kuɗaɗe
  • Stanford PhDs suka ƙirƙira - Dr. Nicolas Kokkalis & Dr. Chengdiao Fan
  • Fiye da Pioneers Miliyan 60 a duniya
ch1-p1: Mataki 1: Sauke Pi Network - Yi amfani da hanyar: minepi.com/chigalex1
ch1-p2: Mataki 2: Yi rajista da Facebook ko Waya → Shigar da lambar: CHIGALEX1 → Samu lada 1 Pi
ch1-p3: Hakar Ma'adinai na Kullum: Koma kowane 24h kuma danna maɓallin walƙiya don ci gaba da hakar ma'adinai.
ch1-list2:
• Kada kayi amfani da sunan ƙarya - dole ne ya dace da ID don KYC
  • Kada ka ƙirƙiri asusu da yawa - mutum ɗaya asusu ɗaya
  • Sanya ƙararrawa don hakar ma'adinai kowane 24h don kiyaye ƙimar
  • Shiga da'irar tsaro bayan kwanaki 3 tare da mutane 5 amintattu
ch1-list:
• Ƙirƙiri walat ɗin Pi cikin aminci
  • Kammala 2FA
  • Kammala KYC
  • Shirya don ƙaura Mainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Tsaron walat: KADA KA taɓa raba kalmomin ɓoye 24 naka! Ƙungiyar Pi Core BAZA taɓa tambayarka ba!
ch2: BABI NA 2 — ILIMIN WALAT ƊIN PI
ch2-p1: Walat ɗin Pi naka bankin ka ne a Pi Ecosystem. Yana riƙe da tsabar kuɗin Pi naka cikin aminci a blockchain.
ch2-p2: Yadda ake ƙirƙira: Buɗe Pi Browser → Wallet → Ƙirƙiri Wallet → KOFA kalmomi 24 naka → Ajiye offline a wurare 2 masu aminci.
ch2-p3: Karɓar Pi: Raba adireshin jama'a (yana farawa da G...). Aika Pi: Manna adireshin mai karɓa, shigar da adadi, tabbatar.
ch2-list:
• Rubuta passphrase akan takarda, ba screenshot ba
  • Ajiye a wurare 2 daban-daban masu aminci (ba waya kaɗai ba)
  • Gwada da 1 Pi kafin aika adadi mai yawa
  • Duba haruffa 4 na farko da 4 na ƙarshe na adireshi koyaushe
ch2a: BABI NA 2A — HORAR DA WALAT MAI AIKI
ch2a-p1: Mai aiki: Fara da ƙaramin adadi na gwaji (1 Pi). Tabbatar haruffa 4 na farko da 4 na ƙarshe na adireshi sun dace. Kada ka taɓa liƙa passphrase akan kowane gidan yanar gizo!
ch2a-p2: Motsa Jiki Kai Tsaye: A cikin wannan horon, za mu yi demo kai tsaye na aika 1 Pi zuwa wani pioneer don gina kwarin gwiwa. Ka tuna: Ma'amalar blockchain ba za a iya juyawa ba!
ch3-p1: Pi Browser kamar Google Play Store ne na Pi. DApps aikace-aikace ne da aka rarraba don amfani na gaske — siyayya, ilimi, wasanni, ayyuka duka suna amfani da Pi.
ch3-list:
• Pi Chain Mall (PCM) - Babban kasuwar Pi
  • WorkforcePool - Ayyuka ga Pioneers
  • CareForPi - Tallafin kiwon lafiya
  • Chigalex1 Hub - Ilimi (Wannan App)
  • Da 100+ ƙarin kayan aiki
ch4-p1: Gano kasuwancin da ke karɓar Pi a duniya akan mapofpi.com. Yi rajistar kasuwancinka kanka kuma fara karɓar Pi don kayayyaki da ayyuka.
ch4-p2: Yadda ake Rajistar Kasuwancinka: Je zuwa mapofpi.com → Haɗa da Pi Wallet → Ƙara Kasuwanci → Ƙara hotuna, wuri, samfura → Abokan ciniki za su same ka! Wannan shine yadda Africa za ta jagoranci karɓar Pi.
ch5-p1: Ƙimar Yarjejeniya ta Duniya (GCV) tana ƙarfafa amfani na gaske. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Pioneers masu amfani da Pi a kasuwanci na gaske ne suka gina wannan ƙimar.
ch5-p2: Ma'anar GCV: GCV ba farashin musayar bane. Yunkuri ne na kare ƙimar Pi ta hanyar amfani da Pi a babban yarjejeniya a cikin cinikayyarmu. Lokacin da muke amfani da Pi don kayayyaki na gaske a GCV, muna ƙirƙirar buƙata da amfani. Wannan ƙarfafa tattalin arziki ne ga Africa.
ch6-p1: Yi nazarin littafin Doris Yin don ƙirƙirar amfani da haɓakar ecosystem. Bincika, koya, kuma koya wa wasu — wannan shine yadda muke ƙarfafa Africa.
ch6-p2: Rawarka a matsayin Africa Pioneer: Koya → Yi aiki → Koya wa mutane 2 → Waɗannan 2 su koya wa 2. Wannan shine yadda zamu kai ga Afirka Miliyan 1 masu ilimi! Sauke Whitepaper, karanta, kuma raba ilimi kullum.
final-msg: Africa tana da damar zama ɗaya daga cikin yankuna mafi ƙarfi a amfani mai amfani a cikin Pi Ecosystem. Tare Muna Ginawa. Tare Muna Koyarwa.
